purpose: Conformance oracle: re-confirms, at the assembled-system/real-browser-UI level, AC-PROD-1, AC-PROD-3, AC-DECLINE-3, AC-DECLINE-9, AC-DECLINE-10, AC-IMMUT-1, and AC-IMMUT-3 — all already established at unit/property level by S2, S3, S5, S6, S7 and cross-cutting-checked by S9. Owns no production module; verifies the assembled system through the app's real UI, publish-through-the-app only. Precedented pattern for e2e-only stories (see epic-contact-pairing-code S6, epic-feature-request-message-edit-and-delete S7, both owning_module='e2e').
dependencies_forbidden: direct import of parseStructured/profileHandler/welcomeSubscription internals to short-circuit a scenario (VQ-S10-003) — every scenario drives the real UI
external_ports: blossom-mock (unused by this spec, but part of the shared e2e infra)
